related_cygnets.description: Solar Shield geomagnetic field perturbations: Real-time ground magnetic field (B-field) perturbations computed as a part of the experimental Solar Shield system. Solar Shield uses real-time L1 plasma and magnetic field measurements to drive SWMF geospace model for predicting 15-30 min lead-time ground magnetic field perturbations.

related_cygnets.title: Retired: Solar Shield - geoelectric field perturbations
related_cygnets.description: Solar Shield geoelectric field perturbations: Real-time ground geoelectric field perturbations computed as a part of the experimental Solar Shield system. Solar Shield uses real-time L1 plasma and magnetic field measurements to drive SWMF geospace model for predicting 15-30 min lead-time ground magnetic field perturbations. The magnetic field perturbations are used together with 1D USGS ground models to model the corresponding geoelectric field (E-field).
